hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r "(.tool_input.content // empty), (.tool_input.new_string // empty), (.tool_input.command // empty)"); if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "api\.alpaca\.markets" && ! echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE "paper-api\.alpaca\.markets"; then echo "BLOCKED: reference to Alpaca LIVE trading endpoint detected. This project is paper-trading only — use paper-api.alpaca.markets." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm -rf /|sudo |git push .*(--force|-f )"; then echo "BLOCKED: matches a dangerous-command pattern (force-push, sudo, or rm -rf). Confirm intent with the user before proceeding." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git commit"; then if git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|(SUPABASE|ANTHROPIC|ALPACA)_[A-Z_]*KEY[^=]*=[^\"]{15,})"; then echo "BLOCKED: staged changes appear to contain a secret or API key. Remove it before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1;; *.py) (ruff format "$FILE" || black "$FILE") >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FILE" in *feature*.py|*train*.py|*analyst*.py|*pack*.py|*alphagate*) echo "Reminder (not a verified check): confirm log returns not raw price, strictly chronological split, no shuffled time-series CV, transaction cost applied before Sharpe/DSR.";; esac; exit 0'
